summary:
## Idea
Compute the nearest rank from an exact integer fraction instead of floating ceil(p*n). p0 returns the minimum and p100 the maximum.

## Complexity
rank uses bounded-width integer arithmetic, O(1). ofSorted indexes O(1) after input validation; percent sorts n samples, O(n log n) time and O(n) storage.

## Use when
A deterministic nearest-rank statistic over a declared sample population is needed.

## Avoid when
Interpolation, a streaming quantile estimator, or inference about an unobserved population is required.

## Pitfalls
A nonempty sample and valid denominator/fraction are required. ceil(0.07*100.0) can choose rank8 rather than exact rank7. Exclude no failed/censored observations without an explicit measurement policy.

## F# usage
Package: FS.GG.Algorithms; cited source API (resolve your actual package pin).
`FS.GG.Algorithms.Numerics.Percentile.percent: int -> 'T list -> 'T when 'T: comparison`

```fsharp
open FS.GG.Algorithms.Numerics
let p95 = Percentile.percent 95 [1; 2; 3; 4; 5]
```

## Tests
PercentileTests: exhaustive counts1..300 and fractions with denominator<=100, BigInteger oracle, floating-formula counterexample and edge/refusal cases.
